source: Intermediate short story written in spoken Palestinian by Claude. NOT native-validated.

sentences.ar: أول مرة حاولت أطبخ لحالي، كانت إمي مسافرة.
sentences.en: The first time I tried to cook by myself, my mom was traveling.
I decided to make mujaddara because it's easy.
I washed the lentils and rice and cut the onions.
I put oil on the fire and fried the onions.

sentences.ar: بس نسيت أخفف النار، والبصل احترق شوي.
sentences.en: But I forgot to lower the heat, and the onions burned a little.

sentences.ar: خفت إنه الأكل يخرب، بس كملت.
sentences.en: I was afraid the food would be ruined, but I continued.
I added the lentils, rice, and water and waited.

sentences.ar: بعد نص ساعة، فتحت الغطا وطلع ريحة حلوة.
sentences.en: After half an hour, I opened the lid and a nice smell came out.

sentences.ar: جربت الأكل وكان طيب أكتر مما توقعت.
sentences.en: I tried the food and it was better than I expected.

sentences.ar: لما رجعت إمي، طبختلها وفتخرت فيي.
sentences.en: When my mom came back, I cooked for her and she was proud of me.
